source: MLCommons MLPerf Inference v4.0, closed division, NVIDIA DGX-H100 (8x H100-SXM-80GB): configurations DGX-H100_H100-SXM-80GBx8_TRT (MaxP) and _MaxQ, Offline scenario; power limits from closed/NVIDIA/configs/*/Offline/__init__.py (applied with nvidia-smi -pl); MaxQ system power metered by a Yokogawa WT333E through SPEC PTDaemon. License: Apache 2.0.
fit: capacity = (L / TDP)^gamma; gamma = ln(MaxQ throughput / MaxP throughput) / ln(L / 700 W)
caveat: MaxQ submissions may also change batch size and other settings, so the ratio is the whole MaxQ configuration, not the power limit alone; inference workloads only.
